cv.name: Ruben Zwart
cv.headline: Financial Analyst – FP&A, forecasting and business partnering
cv.summary: Financial analyst with six years in FP&A at a consumer goods company and a pension administrator. I build forecasts and budgets with the business, look for the story behind the variances and keep reporting simple for management.

experience.title: Financial Analyst FP&A
bullets: Lead the annual budget and rolling forecast for the Benelux business unit (€310M revenue)
Business partner for sales and marketing on trade spend and promotion ROI
Built a driver-based forecast model that shortened the forecast cycle from ten to six working days
Prepare the monthly management report and variance commentary for the leadership team

experience.title: Junior Financial Analyst
bullets: Prepared cost allocation and pricing analyses for pension fund clients
Automated monthly reporting packs in Excel and Power Query

experience.title: Finance Intern
bullets: Supported month-end closing and accruals review
